acceptance: PackageSource supports a canonical GitHub source with repository slug, exact lowercase 40-hex commit revision and optional relative subpath; branches, tags, URLs, credentials and mutable revisions are rejected.
GitHub sources round-trip canonically through aipo.lock TOML/JSON, validate without absolute paths, and retain repository/revision/subpath provenance separately from the content digest.

The resolver can consume deterministic PackageInput values carrying GitHub sources and preserve source identity in graph diagnostics, duplicate detection and lock projection; local path resolution remains unchanged.
A narrow GitHubFetcher/remote-store seam plus an in-memory offline fixture allows tests and embedders to supply manifest/entry bytes without network access or credentials.
No CLI command performs network access, authentication, cache mutation or lifecycle execution; a later adapter must opt in explicitly and preserve the same source contract.
Tests cover canonical round-trip, invalid repository/revision/subpath, source provenance, digest behavior, offline fetched resolution and deterministic errors; repository gates remain green.
